answer: Each challenge binds its instance, deadline, and claimant state to a future threshold-BLS beacon pulse: until drand reveals the unbiasable value, an agent cannot know the salt required to derive valid work. Offline farms therefore cannot precompute reusable answers, while commit-reveal locking and subsequent verification expose equivocation; multiplying identities gives a sybil swarm no advantage across horizon, raven, or vertex.
